name: codex-docker-proxy
description: Codex in Docker bridge mode via a generic proxy; replace image, paths and proxy_port before registration (8080 is illustrative, not a detected port)
before_start: Confirm the HTTP proxy port with the user. Verify host.docker.internal and that port are reachable from the Docker execution host's container network; do not change listener/firewall settings without approval.
after_start: Complete required harness authentication, then verify proxy connectivity from the harness container before normal work. Report failures without silently switching network mode.
special_instructions: The proxy may be Xray or any proxy service supported by the harness. Container loopback is not the host; verify the fixed host.docker.internal address is available. The server generates identical http_proxy/https_proxy plus a common-private-range no_proxy; use all three. Proxy env is not a Docker-daemon/image-pull or bridge-client proxy.
